column1: # Per okderators-catalog-index branch: what catalog-edit.sh (MODE=catalog) appends, and which installed
# CSVs the graph walk starts from. Tab-separated, one row per branch; lists are comma-separated CSV names.
# A row holding TO-FILL stops a catalog run before any edit.
#   REPLACES   the alpha channel's last entry before the edit, exactly (it must also be the channel's
#              single head); the new entry is appended after it with `replaces: <REPLACES>`
#   INSTALLED  CSVs a cluster may run; the walker starts from them too (here: this cluster's CSV)
# release-5.0 read 2026-11-20 (upstream 72eb5d93b1a7, 2026-11-08): alpha ends with the 1.20 build that
# replaces v1.18.0-2025-12-25-214537; this cluster runs that same 1.20 CSV (InstallPlan install-g5zzp,
# 2026-10-27). No entry carries skipRange or skips.
